recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Future changes to the SNOMED CT properties table, including semanticTag wording or localization behavior, should be handled through THO/UTG rather than by restoring the retired core page.
issue_request: FHIR-31032 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by Vocabulary WG and requested a SNOMED CT concept property named semanticTag, data type code, defined as the phrase inside the last set of brackets of the Fully Specified Name.
initial_application: Commit 0bcb947d8488b993d882cc96e556cb3d1e84a94e applied the request by adding semanticTag to source/snomedct.html in the SNOMED CT concept properties table. That source file was later deleted when the external terminology usage pages were removed from core.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 and UP-289 moved the external-code-system Using X pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology. Current core source links the SNOMED CT external code system row to terminology.hl7.org and keeps only the SNOMED CT Usage Summary page in the core hierarchy. The current THO English SNOMED CT page contains the semanticTag row with the requested definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the old SNOMED CT properties table into FHIR core would duplicate intentionally migrated THO content; the current authoritative linked page already satisfies the issue.

related_jiras.note: Moved the external code system usage pages, including SNOMED CT, from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology; this explains why source/snomedct.html is no longer in current core.
Implemented the THO side of the migration and published the Using X with HL7 Standards pages that now carry the SNOMED CT properties table.
